dolphin.name: The Dolphin
dolphin.subtitle: The Affiliative Connector
dolphin.superpower: Creates instant psychological safety, communal belonging, and team cohesion.
dolphin.shadow_alert: Vulnerability to boundary erosion, people-pleasing, and emotional exhaustion from conflict avoidance.

fox.name: The Fox
fox.subtitle: The Tactical Strategist
fox.superpower: Brilliant crisis improvisation, lateral problem-solving, and sharp social reading.
fox.shadow_alert: Risk of being perceived as opportunistic or cynical; emotional guardedness behind an ironic mask.

lion.name: The Lion
lion.subtitle: The Commanding Authority
lion.superpower: Decisive crisis command, high-stakes clarity, and unwavering goal direction.
lion.shadow_alert: Abrasive impatience, steamrolling collaborative input, and autocratic rigidity under stress.

owl.name: The Owl
owl.subtitle: The Intellectual Sage
owl.superpower: Objective risk foresight, flawless empirical analysis, and emotional detachment during chaos.
owl.shadow_alert: Analysis paralysis, intellectual aloofness, and hyper-critical skepticism that alienates peers.

peacock.name: The Peacock
peacock.subtitle: The Expressive Showman
peacock.superpower: Electrifying enthusiasm, visionary storytelling, and ability to break ice across any audience.
peacock.shadow_alert: Shiny-object syndrome, conversational hijacking, and emotional volatility when validation is withheld.

bear_wolf.name: The Bear / Wolf
bear_wolf.subtitle: The Grounded Anchor & Guardian
bear_wolf.superpower: Unshakeable grounding, emotional containment of room anxiety, and steadfast pack loyalty.
bear_wolf.shadow_alert: Stubborn resistance to sudden change, sullen withdrawal, and explosive retaliation when pushed past limits.
